notes: All network requests are intercepted without fallback; package code and payloads are never executed.
The fixture changes only manifest dist.tarball to a same-origin offline route; package archive bytes and evidence remain unchanged.
A replay succeeds only if the product sends the exact frozen source evidence and supplement, aside from the opaque case ID.
Quoted evidence remains validated by the production contract; matching quotes do not prove sound reasoning or runtime behavior.
New isolated-session responses are passed through the production engine/provider with a local transport. No paid API call, exact model identifier, tokens or monetary cost is available.

summary.unionDefinition: Positive if either available decision is positive; negative only if both are available negatives; otherwise abstain. This does not remove false positives.
summary.interpretation: Counts describe these labeled attempts only. Confidence is not a probability; valid evidence references do not establish correct reasoning or complete source coverage.
